Name: Content Patcher Roosters For 1.6
Author: Mearakat
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][u][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/k6rouXD.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/tuy5WCv.png[/img]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/8J9SjiJ.png[/img][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=6]Roosters![/size][/font][img]https://i.imgur.com/KI6d7g5.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Df3HhGw.png[/img][/b][/u][/center]
[center]

This mod aims to add Roosters (Male Chickens) to go with the Hens we already have in game. Sprites are made to match the esthetic of the game and look as if they have always belonged (Or At least attempt to). 
[u][size=6]White and Brown Roosters[/size][/u]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OvqoVBm.jpg[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/REdnEjT.png[/img] 
They dig up (or drop over night when stuck indoors):
Bug Meat (40%), ﻿Bait (30%), ﻿Wild Bait (20%), and Magic Bait (10%)
These Varieties can hatch from their respective eggs, or can be purchased from the shop once you have a deluxe coop.
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________
[u][size=6]Void Roosters[/size][/u]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7HzHrq4.png[/img] 
They dig up (or drop over night when stuck indoors):
Coal (45%), Bat Wing (30%), Void Essence (20%), and Void Ghost Pendant (5%)
Void Roosters Only hatch from Void Eggs. 
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________
[u][size=6]Blue Roosters[/size][/u]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xnyeYey.png[/img] 
Will dig up Mystery Boxes [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Mystery_Box][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/8/87/Mystery_Box.png[/img][/url]
Once you have befriended Shane with at least 8 hearts, you can purchase these from the Ranch. 
(currently have no egg)
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________
[u][size=6]Gold Roosters[/size][/u]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1foBT0a.png[/img]
These Majestic Fowl will dig up/drop a variety of Gems and Geodes.
They can only be hatched from Golden eggs, Thus require completion of [[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Perfection]Perfection[/url]]
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________
Eggs have a 0-5-10-15-20% chance to hatch their corresponding roosters, this is affected by daily luck. To purchase you’ll need to have a [u][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Coop]Deluxe Coop[/url][/u].
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________
[u][size=6]Installation[/size][/u]
Extraction into your mods folder, just as you do with every other stardew valley mod.
[b]Installing [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar - Custom Animal Shops Framework[/url] will clean up Marnie's shop.[/b]﻿
[b]Optional Files:
*[/b] Those who have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url] can give these roosters treats, and exchange them for meat (or gold bars). However the optional files do not have an update key.
